rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for expressing certainty, especially in replies or emphatic statements.

example.jyutping: gaang2 hai6 laa1 nei5 fong3 sam1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the speaker is certain that something is true.

example.english: I am sure he will come today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hang2 ding6 keoi5 gam1 jat6 wui5 lei4

rows.note: Use this for something dependable, safe, or unlikely to fail rather than for certainty of belief.

example.english: Following the instructions exactly is sure to be safe.
example.traditional: 跟足說明書做就穩陣喇。
example.jyutping: gan1 zuk1 syut3 ming4 syu1 zou6 zau6 wan2 zan6 laa3

rows.note: Use this idiom when someone is almost certain to obtain or win something.

example.english: I'm sure I'll get the prize this time.
example.traditional: 呢次個獎我十拿九穩攞到。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 go3 zoeng2 ngo5 sap6 naa4 gau2 wan2 lo2 dou2

rows.note: Use this more formal adjective for something that is inevitable or certain to happen.

example.english: Global warming is sure to cause sea levels to rise.
example.traditional: 全球暖化必然會令海平面上升。
example.jyutping: cyun4 kau4 nyun5 faa3 bit1 jin4 wui5 ling6 hoi2 ping4 min6 soeng5 sing1
